2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_4: Here’s how you can schedule a call with us:
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_6: Simply click on the following link to select a time slot that works best for you: Schedule Your Call
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_1: A few weeks ago, we launched our new app. Our goal is to simplify investing in the capital market. To date, less than 2 out of 10 Europeans invest. One of the main reasons for this is that saving and investing is still perceived as too complex. We want to change that with our new app.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_2: Today we know that with the new app we have partly failed to meet the expectations of active investors like you. We thank you for your honest feedback, which we take very seriously.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_3: We would love to learn directly from you how we can improve our App for you.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Headline: Share your feedback directly with Senior Team Members.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_8: Reply to this email with your availability and we will do our best to accommodate your schedule.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Preheader: Directly with one of our Senior Team Members.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_4_V2: Simply select a date here in our calendar, leave your name and email address, and a senior team member will conduct a call with you to gather and understand your feedback.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_1_V2: A few weeks ago, we launched our new app. Our goal is to simplify investing in capital markets. To date, fewer than 2 out of 10 Europeans invest. One of the main reasons is that saving and investing is still perceived as too complex.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_2_V2: We want to change that with our new app. However, we have not fully met the expectations of active investors like you.
2_2_1_TOP_Email__Body_3_V2: We take customer feedback very seriously. Therefore, we would love to learn directly from you how we can improve our app.
2_2_1_TOP1_Email__Bullet_1: Video Call: You can arrange a video call with one of our experts here.
2_2_1_TOP1_Email__Headline:
Help us improve.
Share your feedback.
2_2_1_TOP1_Email__Body_2: Your insights can make a real difference. Whether you have suggestions for new features, ideas to improve existing ones, or if you simply want to share your experience, we want to hear from you.
2_2_1_TOP1_Email__Body_3: Your input shapes the future of Trade Republic. Thank you for being part of our community.
2_2_1_TOP1_Email__Bullet_2: Call: Reply to this email with your availability and phone number and we will call you.
2_2_1_TOP1_Email__Intro: At Trade Republic, we're dedicated to delivering the best investment experience, and we understand that our new app may not fully meet the expectations of experiences investors like you. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve. We want to hear your thoughts and suggestions.
2_2_1_TOP1_Email__Bullet_3: Email: send your feedback to user-feedback@traderepublic.com.
2_2_1_TOP1_Email__Body_Reward: Share your feedback with us and receive a 100€ cash reward deposited in your Trade Republic account as thank-you for your help.

2_2_1_TOP1PRIV_Email__Body_1: My name is Julian Collin - I lead the Growth & Marketing team at Trade Republic and am the General Manager for our markets.
2_2_1_TOP1PRIV_Email__Body_2: At Trade Republic, we strive to give you the best investment experience. We understand that our new app may not quite meet the expectations of seasoned investors like you. That's something I'd like to change with my team!

2_2_1_TOP1PRIV_Email__Body_4: As a thank you, you will receive 100€ worth of credit transferred to your Trade Republic account.

Julian Collin

2_2_15_VOPA_Email__Content_Nr1: In January, we are required to charge an advance tax known as Vorabpauschale if the value of your investment funds, such as ETFs, has increased in 2023.
2_2_15_VOPA_Email__Content_Nr3:
It is an advanced tax payment collected by the German tax office on investment funds, including ETFs, and is required to be applied by all platforms where you can trade these funds.

You can find more information on how it is calculated in our Help Center.
2_2_15_VOPA_Email__Content_Nr4: When and how will Vorabpauschale be charged?
2_2_15_VOPA_Email__Content_Nr5: The charge will be applied in January, automatically taking into account your 2024 exemption order, ETF loss offset pot amount, or non-assessment certificate.
2_2_15_VOPA_Email__Content_Nr9: Please be aware that we do not provide tax advice. Tax treatment depends on the individual circumstances of each client and may be subject to change in the future to comply with the BaFin regulation.
2_2_15_VOPA_Email__Content_Nr7: Ensure you have sufficient funds in January to cover the charge. In case your account falls into negative, we will notify you and request that you deposit funds within 2 weeks.

Crypto-assets face particular risks on cyber-security, and do not fall within the legal compensation framework and deposit guarantee system.

The value of your virtual currencies can rise or fall sharply, and your initial investment may be lost completely. Virtual currencies are not covered by the guarantee funds that cover bank deposits. There is no legal mechanism on the virtual currencies market to prevent market manipulation or insider dealing. Virtual currencies depend entirely on a specific computer technology and infrastructure, which in certain cases may be very recent and not yet adequately tested. If one loses the identification code or password giving access to the virtual wallet in which the virtual currency is stored, the currency held therein will be irretrievably lost. Virtual currencies are currently accepted as a means of payment to a limited extent, and in most countries there is no legal obligation to accept them. For more information about the risks associated with an investment in virtual currencies, we advise you to read the Wikifin page What is a cryptocurrency? | Wikifin.
